extension-build.description: Builds the Blender extension archives the project's blender_manifest.toml declares through Blender's blender_ext.py, with no Blender installed, one archive per platform the manifest lists and one for every platform where it lists none; a project holding pyproject.toml builds from a staged copy that bundles its local dependencies as subpackages and its locked registry dependencies as the wheels uv selects per platform at the one Python minor its requires-python pins as ==<major>.<minor>.*, leaving out each package its blender dependency group pins as one Blender bundles

package.description: Packs the Adobe UXP plugin or CEP extension the project's other builds wrote, else its tracked source folder: a .ccx zip for a manifest.json, a .zxp ZXPSignCmd signs with a certificate it creates for the build for a CSXS/manifest.xml

install.description: Installs what the project's build wrote in the run's configuration where its host loads it: each package built for this platform through the host's own installer, or the unpacked build folder for a host loading one

release-publish.description: Attaches each host package the target's dependency targets wrote to the GitHub release of the version its manifest states through gh release upload, then publishes it to its host's store where one takes uploads, skipping a version the store holds and a project nx release left unversioned; runs through nx release publish

unreal-build.description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, or packages a .uplugin through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin once per engine its hosts name and archives each package
